profile.headline: Result-Oriented Team Lead | Kubernetes Expert | Customer-Focused | Highly Skilled Professional with Experience in Enterprises and Startups
profile.summary:
- Over 20 years of experience in scaled agile software development and system architecture
- Experience working at a startup going IPO and enterprise software companies
- Lead and mentor kubernetes, cloud platform and devops teams 
- Technical expertise and leadership in technology direction, road-mapping, architecture definition, design, development, and delivery of enterprise-class solutions while adhering to timelines, coding standards, requirements and quality


TECHNICAL SKILLS
Architecture and Design,  Platform As a Service, Devops and Automation, Golang, Erlang/OTP, Java, Bash Scripting, Kubernetes, Docker, API gateway, Service Mesh, TLS Certificates, AWS, Amazon EKS, Azure AKS, Vsphere, GCP, Jenkins, Ansible, Terraform, Consul, Vault

positions.description: Skills: Kubernetes · Go (Programming Language) · Cloud Computing · Distributed Systems · Enterprise Software · VMware Infrastructure

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Leading architecture for Teradata multi-tenant services on public cloud platforms.
- Successfully collaborated with multiple teams, product managers, leadership and customer support to deliver analytics products on kubernetes platform to 100+ enterprise customers.
- Campaigned to promote application containerization and kubernetes adoption for all analytics products
- Leading team of 7 engineers with primary focus on operational excellence, security, reliability, performance and cost optimization of SaaS products.
- Overhauled single tenant service architecture to support multi-tenancy in AWS, resulting in 90% reduction in infrastracture operations and maintenance cost.
- Key member of Devops council. Successfully introduced methodology and practices to automate continuous Integration,  deployments, testing and software delivery in multiple clouds.
- Lead architecture and implementation of continuous integration, deployment, testing and release to the production process. Reduced the release to production cycle from quarterly to 2 weeks.
- Lead design and implementation of platform services for storage, logging, monitoring, security, service mesh and deployment of analytical applications on kubernetes orchestration platform. Technologies used are helm, consul, vault, elasticsearch stack, prometheus,  service mesh, postgres and customer microservices.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Leading design and development of real time infrastructure monitoring platform. The realtime monitoring platform is reliable, fault-tolerant, highly available and deployed in all AWS regions. The platform is used by Apigee to ensure 99.9999 availability for all the customer APIs.

- Architected deployment of highly available monitoring platform that uses custom collectd and telegraf to collect metrics, Influxdb to store timeseries data and Riemann to aggregate metrics and send alerts to email, slack and pagerduty.

- Architected the monitoring platform to be self serviceable. The platform enables applications running on AWS, docker and Kubernetes to collect and send metrics with minimum configuration. The platform enabled each team to integrate and monitor their applications for any issues and handle alerts in real time. 

- Optimized metric data collectors and aggregators that consume minimum cpu and memory footprint. 

- Designed and implemented real time messaging platform in erlang/OTP to collect structured information about actual state of system and deployment topology of all applications and services running in multiple regions on AWS platform

- Implemented core infrastructure microservices using REST API in Go. Developed command line tools and libraries used by deployment and monitoring services to manage infrastructure.

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff - 1
positions.description:
- Leading the design and development of a Merchant Integration Platform product. Merchant Integration Platform proved to be the only enterprise merchant onboarding tool for eBay. 

- Merchant Integration Platform reduced merchant on-boarding duration from 
eight weeks to one week and inventory processing time from two hours to fifteen minutes. 

- Worked directly with enterprise merchants to on-board them on eBay using Merchant Integration Platform.

- Optimized the product to achieve extreme concurrency using map-reduce algorithms and non-blocking components.

- Key team member in architecture and design discussions, regularly proposed solutions to system and product changes that are directly related to their area of focus.

- Working with distributed systems like Hadoop to develop sub components of the system using prototyping and iterations.

positions.title: Software Engineer 3
positions.description:
- Lead development of tools and products that eBay sellers use to list their items on eBay.

- Demonstrated leadership in successfully designing and developing core eBay listing features by leading teams across eBay organizations that located in USA and 
overseas.

- Developed and maintained products that enabled medium to large business sellers to maintain their inventory on eBay using file transfers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Integrated open source image processing library ImageMagick with eBay image platform. The product enabled eBay to deliver images with high quality and dynamic sizes.

- Implemented platform service that enabled eBay’s image platform to host and serve billions of user images on eBay.com with minimum latency.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Worked on open source online learning management system called moodle (www.moodle.org) to implement and customize different modules as needed by the university teaching staff.

- Contributed bug fixes for the quiz module of moodle open source software.
